source_refs.note: i) Catalytic convertor (CC): a main subheading of 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 317-317.

blocks.text: Oxides of nitrogen and other undesirable gases such as CO and various unburnt hydrocarbon are emitted by the vehicle engines. The most cars are equipped with catalytic convertors to convert the harmful pollutants to harmless substances. CO is oxidized to CO₂. NOₓ are reduced to N₂. The unburnt hydrocarbon is converted to CO₂ and H₂O.
